history.body: Hi, saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting at the moment and just starting to look around. Can share a bit more?

Sure — Pearl Residences Phase 1 homes are 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. That gives you flexibility to use a room for work or guests as your needs change. Since you’re just starting to look, are you mainly considering a home to live in yourselves, or exploring an investment?
It’d be for us to live in. We’re only starting to look, so I’m trying to get a feel for the area and what the monthly costs might be like.

For ongoing costs, the stated maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq. ft., inclusive of sinking fund. The standard home is 900 sq. ft., but I don’t want to guess at the monthly total or the area and access details, so I’ll confirm those for you. Selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use rather than all being covered by the maintenance fee, which can help avoid a blanket charge for facilities you may not use.
